title: Acrid Crispy Japanese Sausage Chawanmushi
description: A peppery, crispy sausage custard ideal for post-workout fuel, made sous-vide and finished on a hot-stone plate.
instructions: Season the sausage with salt and crushed pepper, seal in a vacuum bag, and cook in the water bath for 45 minutes.
While the sausage cooks, whisk the eggs, egg whites, dashi, tamari, mirin, and grated ginger in a bowl until smooth.
After 45 minutes, remove the sausage from the bag, pat dry, and sear in a hot pan with sesame oil until golden and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Slice the seared sausage into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a hot-stone plate until very hot, then brush with a little sesame oil to prevent sticking.
Pour the egg-dashi mixture into the hot stone, filling about three-quarters full, then cover tightly.
Steam the custard over indirect heat for 20 minutes, or until the eggs set and the surface is firm.
Remove from the stone, garnish with sliced sausage, chopped green onion, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
Serve immediately, letting the crisp sausage contrast the silky custard.
